summary: Map each contour level to a list of fitted FieldLine objects.

capability: Map each contour level to a list of fitted field-line objects.
operation: contour levels and segments to a level-keyed line collection
contour object exposing levels and allsegs -> dictionary mapping each level to fitted field-line objects
discovery.model: Direct collection construction; no field reconstruction or contour topology repair.
discovery.geometry: Planar contour segments and level labels; segment vertices use caller length units and levels use caller flux-label units.
discovery.boundary: Each segment must be accepted by the FieldLine spline constructor; topology repair and physical flux-surface qualification are excluded.

identity.direction: contour levels and segments to a level-keyed dictionary
identity.definition: For each contour level, construct one FieldLine per segment in the corresponding allsegs entry.
identity.model: Direct collection construction without field reconstruction.
identity.geometry: Planar contour segments and level labels.
identity.coordinates: Segment vertices in caller length units; levels in caller flux-label units.
identity.boundary: Each segment must be accepted by the FieldLine spline constructor.
assumptions: The contour object exposes levels and allsegs.
Segment order and level order are preserved.
Field diagnostics are performed later on each returned line.

inputs.name: contourset
inputs.units: levels in caller flux-label units; vertices length
inputs.constraints: Each allsegs entry contains finite planar segments

outputs.name: collection
outputs.description: Per-level lists of target line objects
outputs.constraints: Keys and segment lists follow contourset.levels/allsegs; each value is a constructed line list.

preconditions: The contour object exposes levels and allsegs.
Segment order and level order are preserved.
supported: Finite contour collections and named FieldLine construction cases.
excluded: Contour topology repair, field reconstruction, and physical flux-surface qualification.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Array or SciPy spline errors from malformed contour segments propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Member FieldLine construction or later diagnostic exceptions propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; collection construction is direct.
failure_semantics.partial_results: The function returns no collection when a segment constructor fails.

example.description: Build a FieldLine collection from one contour level and one segment.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from types import SimpleNamespace
from scirel.geometry.fieldline import contour_points
c=SimpleNamespace(levels=[.2],allsegs=[[np.array([[.2,0.],[.6,0.],[1.,0.]])]])
r=contour_points(c)
assert len(r[.2])==1
example.expected: The returned dict has key 0.2 and contains one FieldLine with 1000 fitted vertices.

scope: Only the explicitly stated finite input domain and direct-test fixtures
verification.evidence_ceiling: Numerical evidence for the named fixtures only; it does not establish arbitrary-input correctness or experimental physical validation.
known_limitations: Intersection is bounded to fitted parameter intervals and rejects no-crossing/multiple-root cases; tangency/completeness remains unqualified
Arbitrary contour topology, magnetic-axis limit and physical stability are unqualified
get_kappa_n_2 requires uniform xy grid and nonzero flux gradient
